aim:
The archetype taster quiz: five questions, option buttons that record an answer and unlock
Next, a step label, and a result reveal. 1 active placement.
contract: - Root `section.tool-archetype-taster-quiz-section[data-component="tool-archetype-taster-quiz"]`.
- **The landing state is part of the contract:** `#quiz-next-btn[disabled]` must be true in

(human-authored 2026-07-14, fence included). This component-scope PLAN is additive; the
two must not drift.

fence's first live trial (the other profile got 200 in the same run); the re-run was clean.
A single red S6 on this subject warrants a re-curl before any diagnosis.

aim:
The idea.uk report-request form: a real POST form into the operator funnel, with an
anti-spam elapsed-time stamp its 266-byte script writes on submit. 1 active placement.
contract: - Root `section.rr-form-section[data-component="report-request-form"]`.
- `form#rr-form[action="/request"][method="POST"]` — the LIVE route (GET /request is the
idea.uk VM app's; the undeliverable-form census counts `/request` as a real destination).
- `input#rr-elapsed[name="_elapsed"]` present — the slot the anti-spam stamp writes into.
- `script[src="/tools/assets/report-request-form.js"]` delivered. NOTE the served tag carries
`defer` — any string-match against it must include the attribute.
- **This fence is STATIC on purpose, and the reason is a boundary, not a gap:** the script's
ONLY observable fires on a real submit of `action="/request"` — which navigates away AND
files a fabricated report request into the `idea_uk_vm_site` lane's operator funnel
(confirm/approve/decline flow). Driving it from acceptance would fabricate a lead in
another lane's money path on every run. DO NOT "upgrade" this fence to a driven one
without that lane's agreement and a harness that stubs the POST.
proof_note: Single-instance placement; page 200. idea.uk 404s `/assets/images/favicon.png` fleet-wide and it was MEASURED not to red no_console_errors (a 2-check probe fence passed clean 2026-08-09) — a resource 404 is a network event, not a console error.
mutants: 8/8 caught, every check watched red, baseline green
